multi_entity_note: Agreement between DGT Corp. (Canada) and Dolphin Industries Limited (Hong Kong).
processing_note: Any notice personally delivered or sent by telex or fax shall be deemed to have been given or received at the time of delivery, telexing or faxing.

contract.document_name.rationale: Title at the top of the agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The parties executed the Agreement on the 1st day of June 2006.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The agreement is 'effective as of the Date of Commencement', which is never defined as a date; June 1, 2006 is the execution date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: No term or expiration date is stated; the 90-day figures describe guaranteed work periods.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Governed by the laws of the State of Nevada, USA; other occurrences are addresses, court jurisdiction or the arbitration statute.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No non-renewal notice provision; the 10/30-day periods are cure periods.
